📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-08
1. Coder's Module Registry Hijacked, Legitimate Domain Briefly Served Credential-Stealing Terraform Modules資安
開發工具平臺 Coder 模組 Registry 遭劫持，合法網域一度提供竊密 Terraform 模組
Coder disclosed that attackers compromised its Cloudflare infrastructure access and injected rogue IPs into the server pool behind registry.coder.com, causing some users to download credential-stealing Terraform modules from the legitimate domain on August 31. The malware exfiltrated stolen credentials to a server impersonating Coder's domain.
Coder 揭露其模組 Registry 遭入侵，攻擊者取得其 Cloudflare 基礎設施存取權，將未授權 IP 加入伺服器位址池，使部分用戶於 8 月 31 日從合法網域下載到植入竊密程式的 Terraform 模組，竊得的憑證會被送往仿冒 Coder 網域的外部伺服器。

2. Critical Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Now Under Active Exploitation資安
Citrix NetScaler 重大身分驗證繞過漏洞遭到實際利用
Citrix's late-August patch for CVE-2026-19490, a critical authentication bypass in NetScaler ADC and Gateway rated 9.3 on CVSS v4.0, is now reportedly being exploited in the wild, affecting certain Gateway and AAA virtual server configurations.
Citrix 8 月下旬修補的重大漏洞 CVE-2026-19490（CVSS v4.0 評分 9.3），影響特定設定的 NetScaler Gateway 與 AAA 虛擬伺服器，如今傳出已遭攻擊者實際利用。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Seattle Times and Newsday Sue OpenAI and Microsoft, Seek Destruction of Models Trained on Their Reporting政策
西雅圖時報與 Newsday 控告 OpenAI、微軟，要求銷毀納入其新聞內容的 AI 模型
The two news organizations filed suit in the Southern District of New York, accusing OpenAI and Microsoft of training AI on their journalism without authorization and surfacing it in search and chat answers. They seek damages and a court order to seize or destroy models and datasets built on their content.
兩家媒體向紐約南區聯邦地方法院提告，指控 OpenAI 與微軟未經授權使用其新聞內容訓練並在搜尋、生成回答中取用，要求損害賠償並扣押或銷毀相關大型語言模型與訓練資料集。
iThome · 原文連結
4. 12-Year-Old PostgreSQL Logical Decoding Flaw Lets Replication Accounts Run Arbitrary Code資安
PostgreSQL 邏輯解碼漏洞潛藏 12 年，複寫帳號可載入任意程式碼
Security firm Cyera detailed CVE-2026-6471, a flaw tracing back to logical decoding added in PostgreSQL 9.4 in 2014. A non-superuser account with REPLICATION privileges can force PostgreSQL to load an arbitrary code library, executing code as the database's OS user.
資安業者 Cyera 公開 CVE-2026-6471 技術細節，問題可追溯至 2014 年 PostgreSQL 9.4 加入的邏輯解碼功能。持有複寫權限但非超級使用者的帳號，可讓 PostgreSQL 載入指定程式庫，以資料庫作業系統帳號執行任意程式碼。
iThome · 原文連結
5. AWS Root Accounts at Over 150 Organizations Targeted in Password-Spraying Campaign資安
AWS 高權限 root 使用者遭密碼噴灑，逾 150 個組織成為攻擊目標
Datadog's security research team disclosed that attackers are targeting the full-access root users of more than 150 AWS accounts with password spraying, though no successful logins have been confirmed. It's unclear how attackers obtained the associated email addresses or their ultimate goal.
Datadog 資安研究團隊揭露，超過 150 個組織的 AWS root 使用者遭到密碼噴灑攻擊，目前尚未發現成功登入案例，攻擊者如何取得相關電子郵件地址及最終目的仍不明朗。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Suspected North Korean Hackers Plant Backdoor in HAProxy Load Balancers to Intercept Traffic資安
疑似北韓駭客將後門植入負載平衡器 HAProxy，可攔截流量並讓 C2 請求避開日誌
Rapid7 uncovered a Linux toolset targeting South Korean media and automotive firms, including a "Ted" backdoor embedded directly in HAProxy that can intercept HTTP connections, steal session cookies, and run remote commands while traffic flows normally. Rapid7 links the activity to a North Korean APT group active since early 2025.
資安業者 Rapid7 揭露鎖定南韓媒體與汽車業的 Linux 攻擊工具，其中「Ted」後門直接植入 HAProxy，能在正常處理流量的同時攔截連線、竊取登入 Cookie 並執行遠端命令，研判與北韓 APT 組織有關，活動可能已持續逾一年。
iThome · 原文連結
7. AI Security Startup HiddenLayer Raises $100M Series B to Expand Agentic Runtime Protection產業
AI 資安業者 HiddenLayer 獲 1 億美元 B 輪融資，擴大 AI 代理執行階段防護
HiddenLayer will use the funding to expand its AI security platform and grow engineering, research, and sales. The company covers generative, predictive, and agentic AI, and this year focused on strengthening runtime security controls for AI agents actually executing tasks.
HiddenLayer 宣布完成 1 億美元 B 輪融資，將用於擴充 AI 安全平臺並投入工程、研究及業務拓展。今年該公司進一步強化 AI 代理實際執行任務時的執行階段安全控管。
iThome · 原文連結
8. AI-Assisted Research Uncovers 'MikroTrick' Exploit Chain in MikroTik Routers資安
波蘭 CERT 借助 AI 模型揪出 MikroTik 路由器漏洞鏈 MikroTrick
CERT Polska said it used the GPT-5.5-cyber and GPT-5.6-sol models to find and report six RouterOS vulnerabilities, two of which can be chained into "MikroTrick" — giving an unauthenticated attacker full control of any SSH-reachable MikroTik router.
波蘭電腦緊急事件應變團隊 CERT Polska 借助 GPT-5.5-cyber 與 GPT-5.6-sol 模型，找出並通報 6 個 RouterOS 資安弱點，其中兩個可串連成 MikroTrick，只要路由器能透過 SSH 遠端存取，未通過身分驗證的攻擊者就有機會完全控制裝置。
iThome · 原文連結
9. GPUThor Attack Shows Rowhammer Can Bypass ECC Protection on Nvidia GPUs研究
多倫多大學揭露新型攻擊 GPUThor，可突破 Nvidia GPU 的 ECC 防護
University of Toronto researchers disclosed GPUThor, a new Rowhammer variant confirmed to defeat ECC protection on Nvidia Ampere-based GPUs including the RTX A4000, A4500, A5000, and A6000. Nvidia was notified in April and published mitigation guidance in late August.
多倫多大學研究人員公開 GPUThor 攻擊手法，證實這種新型 Rowhammer 技術可突破 Nvidia GPU 的 ECC 防護，已於採用 Ampere 架構的 RTX A4000、A4500、A5000 及 A6000 等 GPU 驗證成功，Nvidia 於 4 月接獲通報後在 8 月底發布緩解建議。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Inside OpenAI: How Coding Agents Are Reshaping AI Research Itself研究
OpenAI 內部觀察：程式撰寫代理正在改變 AI 研究本身
OpenAI shares early internal data on how coding agents are changing researcher workflows — shifting usage patterns, faster experiment cycles, and rising task complexity as the company works to accelerate its own research process.
OpenAI 分享內部初步數據，說明程式撰寫代理如何改變研究人員的工作方式，包括代理使用模式轉變、實驗週期加快，以及任務複雜度提升，藉此加速公司自身的研究流程。
